content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Outside Magazine's PostOutside Magazine Verified accountApril 8 at 9:00 PM · Shared with Public Happy Earth Month! This April, we’re stepping up to protect the planet.Here are some of our programs making a difference:–Outside Community Foundation: Our nonprofit supporting youth, underserved communities, and a more inclusive outdoors.–Trailkarma: Support and maintain off-road trails through donations, matching funds, and community partnerships.–Gear Up Give Back: Clean out your gear closet, keep gear out of landfills, support outdoor nonprofits.Join us this Earth Month: volunteer, donate, or give back where you can – together, we can make a lasting impact.#EarthMonth #GetOutsideGiveBack #ProtectThePlanetAll reactions:7LikeCommentAll reactions:7LikeComment
